items.title: What We Still Don’t Know About OpenAI’s Hugging Face Hack
items.summary: The AI giant acknowledges that it could have done far more to prevent its AI agents from going rogue. But it still fails to explain why it didn't see this fiasco coming.
items.author: Maxwell Zeff, Lily Hay Newman

items.title: The Humanoids at China’s Robot Games Were Faster Than Usain Bolt—but I’m More Impressed by Their Tweezer Mastery
items.summary: Beijing’s endlessly delightful Robot Games featured tons of impressive stunts. But the most mind-blowing tricks challenged the humanoid’s brain, not its brawn.
items.author: Will Knight

items.title: Candidates Are Signing a Pact Promising Action on Data Centers and AI Safety
items.summary: More than 15 politicians from across the country have signed on to the AI Pact, vowing to regulate data centers and AI. “We’ve got to get this right,” says Senate candidate Dan Osborn of Nebraska.
items.author: Molly Taft

items.title: AI Slop Is Ruining Cute Animals on the Internet
items.summary: Pet owners, rescue agencies, and wildlife groups are calling for new safeguards as AI makes it harder to tell whether animals, from polar bears to house cats, are real or fake.
items.author: Paresh Dave
